npc_dialog: Hey, you look like someone who could use a few easy dollars. Local businesses pay us to get their flyers out around the city. Just walk around, hand them out, and don't cause trouble.
always_here: Well I'm always here when you're ready
thanks_for_help: Thanks for the help, good luck out there.
already_gave_out: You already gave out the required flyers
all_flyers_handed_out: All flyers have been handed out.
flyers_remaining_get_more: You still have flyers, deliver them then you can get more.
